name: Ana Hernandez
headline: Head of Delivery, Streaming Portfolio
about:
Strategic and impact-driven Head of Delivery with 15+ years of experience leading large-scale digital and streaming portfolios across complex, cross-functional environments. Proven track record of shaping and executing delivery strategies that align business outcomes with technology, driving measurable improvements in flow, efficiency, and customer experience.

Expert in leading high-performing delivery organisations, managing and coaching Delivery Managers, and transitioning teams from squad-based models to value stream–aligned structures. Strong focus on optimising the Software Development Lifecycle through data-driven insights, leveraging metrics to enable predictable, scalable delivery.

Recognised for influencing at the executive level, building trusted relationships with C-level stakeholders, and navigating complex organisational change. Extensive experience in agile transformation, governance design, and continuous improvement initiatives, including large-scale platform evolution and strategic decision-making across build vs. buy scenarios.

Passionate about fostering a culture of accountability, empowerment, and innovation, with a strong emphasis on leadership development, cross-team alignment, and delivering sustainable business value. Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive outcomes from vision through to delivery.
… more

experiences.description:
Own the end-to-end delivery of portfolio outcomes across a complex ecosystem spanning customer-facing products and core platforms, driving alignment between product, engineering, and business strategy. Lead multi-disciplinary teams including capability teams and value streams, embedding scalable delivery practices, improving flow efficiency, and enabling high-quality, predictable outcomes at pace.
Drive organisational agility and continuous improvement initiatives, shaping operating models, governance, and delivery standards to support long-term strategic goals.


Key Responsibilities:
• People Leadership & Coaching across Delivery Managers and cross-functional teams
• Portfolio-Level Delivery Ownership across multiple capability teams and value streams
• Operating Model Design & Agile Transformation
• Product, Engineering & Business Alignment at scale
• Executive Stakeholder Management & Strategic Communication
• Strategic Planning, Roadmapping & Quarterly Planning (BRP)
• Delivery Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement
• Risk, Dependency & Issue Management across complex systems
• Cross-Team Coordination for large-scale initiatives and releases

experiences.position: Senior Delivery Manager – Streaming Connected TV Apps
experiences.description:
As Senior Iteration Manager for Connected TV apps, I apply strategic scaled agile practices tailored to each squad. I work closely with senior leadership to drive continuous improvement and champion a culture that prioritises rapid iteration and experimentation to deliver key results. By identifying and addressing capability gaps, I foster a growth mindset within teams, instilling trust, collaboration, and an agile approach that empowers diverse, high-performing teams to deliver valuable outcomes.

I lead the ongoing planning and prioritisation of initiatives in different Squads, partnering with senior stakeholders to tackle systemic delivery inefficiencies and proactively manage complex risks. With a strong focus on transparency, I clearly communicate strategic outcomes and progress to C-level audiences, ensuring alignment from top leadership down to individual contributors.

I introduce and implement key metrics aligned with our goals to support data-informed decision-making. By embedding collaborative governance practices and aligning product and technology teams, I help streamline the product lifecycle to optimise the rapid delivery of our roadmap.

Additionally, I serve as a coach to leaders, employing diverse coaching methods to help teams overcome challenges and to build an agile, collaborative mindset that empowers diverse teams to deliver meaningful outcomes
